units.source_text: 首先，一次要摄取一百一十二克以上，否则就没有营养价值。

en.t: First of all, one must take in more than one hundred and twelve grams at a time, or else it has no nutritional value.

units.source_text: 说到一百一十二克松叶，大约可以装满这顶帽子吧。

en.t: As for one hundred and twelve grams of pine needles, it would probably fill this hat.

units.source_text: 如果大口大口地吃，第一，带有草腥味儿，催人呕吐；

en.t: If you eat them in large mouthfuls, first, they have a grassy smell and make you feel like vomiting;
second, it takes quite a lot of time.

units.source_text: 难道就没有办法既不丧失精华部分，又能最有效果地精制，让人容易服用吗？

en.t: Is there really no way to refine them most effectively without losing their essential parts, and make them easy for people to take?

units.source_text: 所以，长期以来有许多人进行了苦心研究，

en.t: Therefore, for a long time many people carried out painstaking research,

units.source_text: 现在争议中的星制药公司社长星一先生，是个赚了很多钱又亏了许多钱的名人。

en.t: Mr. Hoshi Hajime, the president of Hoshi Pharmaceutical Company, now at the center of controversy, is a famous man who made a great deal of money and also lost a great deal.

units.source_text: 这位星先生从美国进口了五万几千美元的冷冻机，可以冷却到零下三十几度，起到如同火烤般的作用，

en.t: This Mr. Hoshi imported from America a refrigerator costing over fifty thousand dollars, which could cool things to more than thirty degrees below zero and produce an effect like roasting over fire,

units.source_text: 然后制成粉末，他把这种方法应用到松叶制作上，获得了成功，

en.t: and then turn them into powder; he applied this method to the preparation of pine needles and succeeded,

units.source_text: 也就是这种被称为松之绿的食品。

en.t: namely this food known as Pine Green.
